title: Sparkly paper boat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Water ripples -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='42' ry='8' fill='#1565C0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='36' ry='6' fill='#1E88E5'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='28' ry='4' fill='#42A5F5'/>
  
  <!-- Boat hull -->
  <polygon points='18,66 82,66 70,80 30,80' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  <polygon points='18,66 82,66 76,72 24,72' fill='#FFF176'/>
  <!-- Hull shading -->
  <polygon points='30,80 70,80 76,72 24,72' fill='#FDD835'/>
  
  <!-- Fold lines on hull -->
  <line x1='50' y1='66' x2='50' y2='80' stroke='#F9A825' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='34' y1='66' x2='38' y2='80' stroke='#F9A825' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='66' y1='66' x2='62' y2='80' stroke='#F9A825' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Left sail -->
  <polygon points='50,66 50,30 24,58' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <polygon points='50,66 50,30 24,58' fill='#F5F5F5' opacity='0.6'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='30' x2='24' y2='58' stroke='#E0E0E0' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Right sail -->
  <polygon points='51,66 51,34 76,60' fill='#ECEFF1'/>
  <line x1='51' y1='34' x2='76' y2='60' stroke='#CFD8DC' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Mast -->
  <line x1='50' y1='28' x2='50' y2='68' stroke='#BCAAA4' stroke-width='2'/>
  
  <!-- Sail fold crease left -->
  <line x1='50' y1='46' x2='34' y2='60' stroke='#E0E0E0' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <!-- Sail fold crease right -->
  <line x1='51' y1='46' x2='66' y2='60' stroke='#CFD8DC' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <!-- Sparkle 1 -->
  <g transform='translate(20,30)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-6' x2='0' y2='6' stroke='#FFEB3B' stroke-width='1.8'/>
    <line x1='-6' y1='0' x2='6' y2='0' stroke='#FFEB3B' stroke-width='1.8'/>
    <line x1='-4' y1='-4' x2='4' y2='4' stroke='#FFF59D' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='4' y1='-4' x2='-4' y2='4' stroke='#FFF59D' stroke-width='1'/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Sparkle 2 -->
  <g transform='translate(78,26)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-5' x2='0' y2='5' stroke='#FFEB3B' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='-5' y1='0' x2='5' y2='0' stroke='#FFEB3B' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='-3' y1='-3' x2='3' y2='3' stroke='#FFF59D' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='3' y1='-3' x2='-3' y2='3' stroke='#FFF59D' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Sparkle 3 -->
  <g transform='translate(14,52)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-4' x2='0' y2='4' stroke='#FFEB3B' stroke-width='1.3'/>
    <line x1='-4' y1='0' x2='4' y2='0' stroke='#FFEB3B' stroke-width='1.3'/>
    <line x1='-2.5' y1='-2.5' x2='2.5' y2='2.5' stroke='#FFF59D' stroke-width='0.7'/>
    <line x1='2.5' y1='-2.5' x2='-2.5' y2='2.5' stroke='#FFF59D' stroke-width='0.7'/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Sparkle 4 -->
  <g transform='translate(86,46)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-4' x2='0' y2='4' stroke='#FFEB3B' stroke-width='1.3'/>
    <line x1='-4' y1='0' x2='4' y2='0' stroke='#FFEB3B' stroke-width='1.3'/>
    <line x1='-2.5' y1='-2.5' x2='2.5' y2='2.5' stroke='#FFF59D' stroke-width='0.7'/>
    <line x1='2.5' y1='-2.5' x2='-2.5' y2='2.5' stroke='#FFF59D' stroke-width='0.7'/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Sparkle 5 (small dot) -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='22' r='2' fill='#FFEB3B'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='22' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <!-- Sparkle 6 (small dot) -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='18' r='1.8' fill='#FFEB3B'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='18' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <!-- Sparkle 7 (tiny diamond) -->
  <g transform='translate(10,44)'>
    <polygon points='0,-3 2,0 0,3 -2,0' fill='#FFEB3B'/>
    <polygon points='0,-1.5 1,0 0,1.5 -1,0' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Sparkle 8 (tiny diamond) -->
  <g transform='translate(90,62)'>
    <polygon points='0,-3 2,0 0,3 -2,0' fill='#FFEB3B'/>
    <polygon points='0,-1.5 1,0 0,1.5 -1,0' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Extra tiny sparkle dots -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='38' r='1.2' fill='#FFF59D'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='40' r='1.2' fill='#FFF59D'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='18' r='1' fill='#FFEB3B'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='22' r='1' fill='#FFEB3B'/>
  
  <!-- Water reflections -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='82' rx='8' ry='2' fill='#64B5F6' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='84' rx='6' ry='1.5' fill='#64B5F6' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='10' ry='2' fill='#90CAF9' opacity='0.4'/>
</svg>
